top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Fall as Oil Adds to Inflation Fears: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks dropped, tracking losses on Wall Street, as surging oil prices stoked concern that inflation will accelerate. Brent crude held above $101 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: UBS CEO flags investor complacency as geopolitical and economic risks mount
top_signals.summary: UBS CEO Sergio Ermotti warns financial markets have grown complacent despite mounting geopolitical and economic risks.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
